question: An equilateral triangle of side 12 cm is inscribed in a circle. What is the area (in cm²) of the circle?
solution:
Given:

An equilateral triangle of side 12 cm is inscribed in a circle.

Concept used:

Circumradius of an equilateral triangle = {A over sqrt3} unit (A being the length of each side of it)

Area of a circle = πr²

Where r = radius of the circle
